phone.setupSubtitle: adbData copies files between an Android phone and this PC through adb, Google's debugging tool. The phone needs no app and no root.
phone.adbMissingBody: adb comes in Google's platform-tools. adbData can download them (about 7 MB) into its own folder; nothing else on the computer changes.
phone.adbBrokenBody: The adb found does not answer: {detail} Download a fresh copy, or choose another one in Settings.
phone.terms: The download comes from Google and is under its terms:
phone.step1: On the phone, open Settings, then About phone, and tap Build number seven times. Developer options appear.
phone.step2: In Developer options, turn on USB debugging.
phone.step3: Connect the phone with a USB cable that carries data, not only power. A USB 3 port and cable can copy faster, when the phone supports it.
phone.step4: Unlock the phone and allow USB debugging for this computer when it asks. Tick Always allow, so it does not ask again.
phone.cableHint: The phone does not need to be in file transfer (MTP) mode; charging only is fine.
phone.unauthorizedTitle: Allow USB debugging on the phone
phone.unauthorizedBody: The phone shows a question about this computer's key. Unlock it, tick Always allow from this computer, and choose Allow. If no question appears, unplug the cable and plug it in again.
phone.offlineBody: It may be starting, locked or asleep. Unlock it; if it stays like this, unplug the cable, or turn USB debugging off and on again.
phone.noPermissionTitle: This computer may not open the phone
phone.noPermissionBody: On Linux, add a udev rule for Android devices and plug the phone in again.
phone.otherModeTitle: The phone is in recovery or the bootloader
phone.otherModeBody: Start it normally to copy files.

browse.name: Name
browse.emptyFiltered: No files of these kinds here.
browse.listFailed: The folder could not be read
browse.hint: Select files and folders to copy, or copy everything shown.
browse.copyFolder: Copy everything shown to this PC

send.pickFiles: Files to send to the phone
send.pickFolder: A folder to send to the phone

options.skipHint: A file of the same name and size is left alone, so copying a folder again copies only what is new. A different file of that name is kept, and the new one gets a number.
options.keepBothHint: Every file is copied; one whose name is taken gets a number, as IMG_1 (2).jpg.
options.replaceHint: A file of the same name is overwritten.
options.keepDatesHint: Copies keep the date the file was last changed on the phone, so photos sort by when they were taken.
options.checkHint: Compares each copy with the original by its MD5 checksum after copying. Takes longer; a copy that differs is removed and reported.

review.planFailed: The copy could not be planned
review.nothing: Nothing to copy: everything is already there.

skipped.one: {count} file ({size}) is already there and is skipped.
skipped.other: {count} files ({size}) are already there and are skipped.

filtered.one: {count} file of another kind is left out.
filtered.other: {count} files of other kinds are left out.

renamed.one: {count} name has characters Windows does not allow; they become _.
renamed.other: {count} names have characters Windows does not allow; they become _.

numbered.one: {count} file gets a number because its name is taken.
numbered.other: {count} files get a number because their names are taken.

unreadable.one: {count} link or unreadable name is left out.
unreadable.other: {count} links or unreadable names are left out.

review.noRoomBody: The copy needs {need}, and {free} is free. Choose another folder, or fewer files.

copy.title: Copy
copy.noneBody: Choose files on the Phone page and copy them; this page shows how it goes.
copy.checkUnavailableTitle: The copies could not be checked
copy.checkUnavailableBody: This phone has no md5sum. The files were copied; only the check was skipped.
copy.disconnectedTitle: The connection to the phone was lost
copy.disconnectedBody: Plug the phone in again and copy once more: files already copied are skipped, so it continues where it stopped.

failure.local: Could not be written on this PC: {detail}
failure.mismatch: The copy differed from the original and was removed
failure.disconnected: Not copied: the phone went away

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Every copy adbData made, newest first.

showFailed.one: Show the file that was not copied
showFailed.other: Show the {count} files that were not copied

history.clearBody: The list of past copies is removed. The copied files stay where they are.

settings.title: Settings
settings.destination: Copies from the phone go to
settings.destinationHint: Each copy can choose another folder before it starts.
settings.pickDestination: Where copies from the phone go
settings.showHiddenHint: Names starting with a dot: thumbnails, the phone's trash and app data. Off, they are neither shown nor copied.
settings.adbPathHint: The full path of adb.exe, if you want a particular one. A path copied with Copy as path works as it is.
settings.aboutBody: adbData copies files between an Android phone and a PC over adb, which is faster and steadier than Windows' own phone connection (MTP), and keeps the files' dates.
